title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
abstract: arXiv:2611.31094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. translated_title: 通过循环残差解锁预训练大语言模型中循环结构的潜力
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过迭代共享的层块来增加计算量而无需增加参数，从而提供更强的性能和测试时扩展能力。然而，迄今为止，这种能力需要从头开始训练，且对大语言模型只能带来有限的收益。将现有模型微调成循环结构虽然成本低得多，但相比SFT也只能带来边际提升。我们提出LoopRes，一种有效、可扩展且简单的方法，能够将循环转化为预训练大语言模型的显著且一致的增益。LoopRes建立在注意力残差的基础上，让每个循环层能够直接关注早期循环的输出。由于这些输出是相同层迭代产生的结果，彼此越来越难以区分，我们为每个输出提供一个可训练的、感知循环的键来编码其结构身份。关注所有早期循环还允许各层跳过中间循环，因此我们将每层限制在最近W个循环组成的残差窗口内，强制每个循环进行逐步构建
tldr: LoopRes通过让每个循环层借助可训练的循环感知键直接关注早期循环的输出（并限制在残差窗口内），使预训练大语言模型无需从头训练即可将循环结构转化为显著且一致的增益。
en_tdlr: LoopRes turns looped transformers into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs by letting each looped layer attend to earlier loop outputs through trainable loop-aware keys within a residual window, avoiding training from scratch.
